LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Sanctuary016.nodes.0.desc: Requires Group Sanctuary learned from its augment. Retains its 5-cell radius, line of sight, 1-second protection and skill recovery. Later nodes require your own Sanctuary to block an enemy hit; other protection sources do not count. All protected recipients share the caster’s node cooldowns.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Sanctuary016.nodes.1.desc: When your Sanctuary blocks an enemy hit, mark the attacker for 4 seconds. One mark, created once per 6 seconds. Your later ordinary hit consumes it for 50 bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Sanctuary016.nodes.2.desc: When your Sanctuary blocks an enemy hit on another colonist, heal 20 base points on the most injured other eligible colonist within 4 cells of you and clear sight, once per 6 seconds. Protecting yourself does not trigger it. With no injured ally it does not heal you instead. Base rewards: healing 20.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Sanctuary016.nodes.3.desc: After Sanctuary Reprisal deals bonus damage, strike one other enemy within 3 cells of the impact and clear sight for 25 damage, once per 6 seconds. Never hits the original target again. Base rewards: damage 25.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Sanctuary016.nodes.4.desc: After Sanctuary Reprisal deals bonus damage, gain a separate 2-base-point shield for 3 seconds, once per 6 seconds. Does not extend Sanctuary’s damage prevention. Base rewards: shield 50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Sanctuary016.nodes.5.desc: After Sheltered Recovery actually heals an injury, shield the nearest other eligible colonist within 4 cells of you and clear sight for 50 base points over 3 seconds, once per 6 seconds. The shield recipient may differ from the healed colonist. Base rewards: shield 50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Sanctuary016.nodes.6.desc: After Sheltered Recovery actually heals an ally, heal 20 base points of your own recoverable injuries, once per 6 seconds. No actual ally healing means no benefit. Cannot restore missing parts or permanent scars. Base rewards: healing 20.
